First incident: assault causing light injury. That's "故意伤害". Yes.

Second incident: making false terrorist information, causing police to take emergency measures, disturbing social order. That likely is "编造虚假恐怖信息罪" which corresponds to "聚众扰乱社会秩序"? Thus two charges: 故意伤害;聚众扰乱社会秩序
